blocks.text: Electron microscope mein electrons ka beam (dhaara) cheez mein se guzarta hai. Magnetic lenses is beam ko screen ya photographic film par focus karte hain aur bohat bara image banate hain. Is ki resolving power light microscope se bohat zyada hai: yeh 0.2 nanometre (nm) jitni chhoti cheez bhi saaf dikha deta hai, aur 1 nm = 1/1000,000 mm (millimetre ka das lakhwan hissa). Lekin electron microscope se zinda cheez nahi dekhi ja sakti, kyun ke specimen tayyar karne ke tareeqe cell ko zinda nahi rehne dete. Biologists do qisam ke electron microscopes istemal karte hain.

Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM) cell ki andar ki banawat dekhne ke liye hai. TEM electrons ka beam bohat patle specimen ke aar-paar guzarta hai. Yeh cheezon ko 250,000 guna tak bara kar sakta hai. Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) cells ya kisi bhi cheez ki surface (satah) ki detail dekhne ke liye hai. Surface par metal ki tah chadhai jati hai. Jab electron beam metal se takrata hai to woh reflect (palat) ho kar bara image banata hai. SEM cheezon ko 100,000 guna tak bara kar sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Desk par rakha electron microscope: oonchi column jis ke oopar electron gun ka khol hai; column ke beech mein specimen holder (Specimen placed here, yahan specimen rakha jata hai); column ke neeche viewing chamber (Image viewed here, yahan image dekhi jati hai); desk par control panels aur monitor.

blocks.alt: (a) Scanning electron microscope: oopar electron source, phir condenser lenses, aperture, scanning coil aur objective lens bareek beam ko sample par dalte hain; back-scattered electron detector aur secondary electron detector sample se aane wale electrons pakarte hain, aur signal amplifier se computer screen tak jata hai; scan generator beam ko chalata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.4: (a) Scanning electron microscope aur (b) Transmission electron microscope ke kaam ka usool (textbook ki Figure 3.4 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: (a) Scanning electron microscope: oopar electron source, phir condenser lenses, aperture, scanning coil aur objective lens bareek beam ko sample par dalte hain; back-scattered electron detector aur secondary electron detector sample se aane wale electrons pakarte hain, aur signal amplifier se computer screen tak jata hai; scan generator beam ko chalata hai. (b) Transmission electron microscope: electron source, condenser lenses, condenser aperture, sample, objective lens, objective aperture, intermediate lenses, projective lens, aur neeche fluorescent screen aur camera.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: TEM mein electrons patle sample ke aar-paar (transmit) jate hain, is liye andaruni banawat nazar aati hai aur image neeche screen par banti hai. SEM mein beam sample ki satah par phirai jati hai (scan), aur satah se uchhalne wale electrons detectors pakarte hain; is liye satah ki 3D jaisi tasveer milti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “zinc sulphate” chhapa hai. Electron microscope ki fluorescent screen par zinc sulphide (ZnS) ki teh hoti hai, zinc sulphate ki nahi. Table mein sahi naam likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek talib-e-ilm kehta hai ke 100X objective aur 15X eyepiece wala light microscope 0.1 µm ke fasle par do nuqton ko alag-alag dikhayega. Is dawe mein kya ghalat hai?
blocks.explanation: Kul magnification 100 × 15 = 1500X hai, jo light microscope ki had hai, magar magnification resolution nahin hai. Light microscope taqreeban 0.2 µm se qareeb kuch resolve nahin kar sakta, is liye 0.1 µm ke fasle par do nuqte chahe kitne bhi bare kiye jayen ek mein mil jayenge. Electron microscope, jo 0.2 nm resolve karta hai, unhen alag kar sakta hai.

items: Magnification yeh hai ke image kitne guna bara hai (lenses zarb hote hain); resolution woh sab se chhota fasla hai jo do nuqton ke taur par dekha ja sake.
Light microscope: roshni aur sheeshe ke lenses; 1500X tak; 0.2 µm resolve karta hai; zinda ya stained namoone, magar staining aam taur par cells maar deti hai.
Electron microscope: electron beam aur magnetic lenses; 0.2 nm resolve karta hai; murda, khaas tayyar-shuda namoone. TEM andaruni banawat dikhata hai (250,000X); SEM satah dikhata hai (100,000X).
